title: In JetBrains CLion before 2026.2, 2026.1.4 code execution was possible in Safe Mode via Meson project settings…
description: A critical vulnerability in JetBrains CLion before version 2026.2 and 2026.1.4 allows code execution in Safe Mode via Meson project settings. This flaw enables an attacker to execute arbitrary code despite the application running in a restricted Safe Mode environment.
